articles.headline: Wilson, Young double up to send Aces past Tempo 93-73 in first game without Smith
articles.description: — A'ja Wilson had 27 points and eight rebounds, Jackie Young scored 23 points, and the Las Vegas Aces beat the Toronto Tempo 93-73 on Friday night.

articles.headline: Dream's Angel Reese won't be suspended after WNBA rescinds tech
articles.description: The WNBA rescinded the technical foul that Dream forward Angel Reese picked up Friday against Portland, meaning she remains at seven on the season and will not be suspended for Sunday's game against Minnesota.

articles.headline: Rae Burrell scores 12 of her 15 points in 4th as the Sparks beat the Mystics 88-82
articles.description: — Nneka Ogwumike had 24 points, Rae Burrell scored 12 of her 15 points in the fourth quarter, and the Los Angeles Sparks beat the Washington Mystics 88-82 on Friday night.

articles.headline: Dream's Angel Reese faces suspension after 8th technical foul
articles.description: Dream forward Angel Reese picked up her eighth technical foul Friday against Portland, meaning she will be suspended for Sunday's game against Minnesota unless the league rescinds the tech on review.

articles.headline: Clark, Mitchell combine for 68 in Fever's blowout win over Sun
articles.description: Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell dominated the action for the Fever on Friday night, lighting up the Sun with 34 points apiece in a 111-91 rout.
